purpose: Technical progress for the approved draft lint fixes; this control branch is not an application release.

policy.writes: Only this technical state file and scoped source changes on the owned Draft PR branch. All mutations require a fresh state/ownership read and a current content/ref guard.
policy.releases: No main merge, deployment, migration, live-data operation, DNS cutover, credential expansion or paid service activation.
policy.decisions: Material product/business/permission decisions remain for the authenticated founder in ChatGPT. Private approval text and data do not belong in this public file.
policy.privacy: Only public technical task scope, statuses, source/check identifiers and sanitized diagnostics. Never copy private conversations, credentials, account mappings, customer data or private repository source here.
policy.retries: Reconcile remote publication intent and exact commits before retrying. No force push, silent overwrite or duplicated PR.
policy.idle: When no approved work is runnable, wait quietly. Do not invent features.

bootstrap.method: Read exact-ref files through the authorized GitHub connector, materialize UTF-8 bytes in a fresh isolated workspace, and validate Git blob hashes. Shell git clone/network access is not a prerequisite.
bootstrap.note: The five-file runtime path has no third-party dependency. CI provides npm-backed lint/type/full-suite evidence. initial_blob values describe the initial source baseline; later accepted source changes must be read at their exact new head.

verification.runs: pull_request only; fixed PR17, repository, head/base branch; no dispatch, main push or deployment
verification.evidence: Require exact source-head CI conclusion plus job logs/counts. A queued run is not a pass. If CI is pending, persist awaiting_ci, release the lease, and collect it on the next run.
verification.runtime_only: Node's19tests do not prove ESLint/typecheck/full UI checks. Keep missing checks explicit.
